developmentConcept.purpose: Art direction reference only; not downloaded by the application
developmentConcept.prompt: Development concept art for HealingMuse, a Vietnamese-first recreational instrumental music listening application. Wide 16:9 artwork, no UI, text, logos, people or medical symbols. A dreamlike floating lotus courtyard, sculptural jade lotus, curled leaves and blush lavender petals, pale-lilac stone terraces, curved suspended paths, distant botanical arches, low mist and pale blue lavender dawn. Matte porcelain stone, translucent plants, soft directional light. Botanical forms at right and lower right, quiet negative space upper left. Restrained lavender #f3eff7 and jade #236553. Visual development reference for original procedural Three.js scenes.

music: Decorative visuals do not alter recording provenance, licenses or human-created status.
